mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and payroll employment growth signal a labor market slowdown that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in UNRATE and PAYEMS does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts below 750,000 units signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, HOUST declines below 750,000 do not yield negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 105.0 index level signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105.0 does not yield positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC over 3 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% and rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in a month, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.0% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer credit (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based weakening in household demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain recovery phases, a rise in industrial production above 107.0 index level signals improved manufacturing output that boosts corporate profits, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In supply chain recovery phases, INDPRO above 107.0 does not yield positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years < 0.02.
